added_spans.sentence_en: The Governing Council today decided to keep the three key ECB interest rates unchanged.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 管理委员会今天决定维持欧洲央行三项关键利率不变。

added_spans.sentence_en: The Governing Council today decided to keep the three key ECB interest rates unchanged.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 管理委员会今天决定维持欧洲央行三项关键利率不变。

added_spans.sentence_en: Energy prices have continued to rise, posing upside risks to the inflation outlook and downside risks to the growth outlook.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 能源价格继续上涨，给通胀前景带来上行风险，给增长前景带来下行风险。
added_spans.text_en: Energy prices have continued to rise, posing upside risks to the inflation outlook and downside risks to the growth outlook.

added_spans.sentence_en: While the full effects of the energy shock are still unfolding, underlying inflation has remained broadly stable so far and wages do not show a material response at this stage.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 能源冲击的全部影响仍在显现，但到目前为止，基础通胀大体保持稳定，工资现阶段也没有明显反应。
added_spans.text_en: While the full effects of the energy shock are still unfolding, underlying inflation has remained broadly stable so far and wages do not show a material response at this stage.

added_spans.sentence_en: The increased magnitude and duration of the energy shock, as well as the implications for indirect and second-round effects, are likely to drive up inflation and lower growth.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 能源冲击的幅度加大、持续时间延长，加上间接效应和第二轮效应，可能推高通胀、压低增长。
added_spans.text_en: The increased magnitude and duration of the energy shock, as well as the implications for indirect and second-round effects, are likely to drive up inflation and lower growth.

added_spans.sentence_en: Financing conditions have tightened since the Governing Council’s last meeting, which is likely to weigh on inflation and growth.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 自管理委员会上次会议以来，融资条件有所收紧，这可能抑制通胀和增长。
added_spans.text_en: Financing conditions have tightened since the Governing Council’s last meeting, which is likely to weigh on inflation and growth.

added_spans.sentence_en: The Governing Council is committed to setting monetary policy to ensure that inflation stabilises at its 2% target in the medium term.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 管理委员会致力于制定货币政策，确保通胀在中期稳定在 2% 的目标。

added_spans.sentence_en: The Governing Council is committed to setting monetary policy to ensure that inflation stabilises at its 2% target in the medium term.

added_spans.sentence_en: The Governing Council remains well positioned to navigate the current elevated uncertainty.
added_spans.sentence_zh: 管理委员会仍处于有利位置，能够应对当前较高的不确定性。

old.en: The baseline of the new ECB staff projections sees headline inflation averaging 3.0% in 2026, 2.5% in 2027 and 2.1% in 2028.
old.zh: 欧洲央行工作人员新预测的基准情形显示，整体通胀 2026 年平均为 3.0%，2027 年为 2.5%，2028 年为 2.1%。

old_spans.text: The baseline of the new ECB staff projections sees headline inflation averaging 3.0% in 2026, 2.5% in 2027 and 2.1% in 2028.

old.en: For inflation excluding energy and food, the baseline foresees 2.5% in 2026, 2.6% in 2027 and 2.3% in 2028.
old.zh: 剔除能源和食品的通胀，基准情形预计 2026 年为 2.5%，2027 年为 2.6%，2028 年为 2.3%。

old_spans.text: For inflation excluding energy and food, the baseline foresees 2.5% in 2026, 2.6% in 2027 and 2.3% in 2028.

old.en: Compared with June, the baseline projection for inflation in 2026 is unchanged, while it has been revised up for 2027 and 2028.
old.zh: 与 6 月相比，2026 年通胀的基准预测不变，2027 年和 2028 年的预测上调。

old_spans.text: Compared with June, the baseline projection for inflation in 2026 is unchanged, while it has been revised up for 2027 and 2028.

old.en: The baseline projection for economic growth is 0.9% for 2026, 1.4% for 2027 and 1.5% for 2028.

old_spans.text: The baseline projection for economic growth is 0.9% for 2026, 1.4% for 2027 and 1.5% for 2028.

old.en: This is an upward revision for both 2026 and 2027, mainly reflecting the greater than expected resilience of the euro area economy.
old.zh: 2026 年和 2027 年的增长预测均上调，主要反映欧元区经济的韧性强于预期。

old_spans.text: This is an upward revision for both 2026 and 2027, mainly reflecting the greater than expected resilience of the euro area economy.

old.en: The outlook remains highly uncertain, with risks to the upside for inflation and to the downside for economic growth.
old.zh: 前景仍高度不确定，通胀面临上行风险，经济增长面临下行风险。

old_spans.text: The outlook remains highly uncertain, with risks to the upside for inflation and to the downside for economic growth.

old.en: In relation to the energy shock, the updated scenarios put together by staff illustrate the broad range of outcomes for how growth and inflation would evolve under different assumptions about its intensity and duration, as well as its indirect and second-round effects.
old.zh: 关于能源冲击，工作人员更新的情景分析显示，在对冲击强度、持续时间及其间接效应和第二轮效应的不同假设下，增长和通胀的演变可能差别很大。
